title: Bill Gebhardt - Replicating Discretionary Commodity Trading Systematically (S7E9)

reader_summary.headline: A word of mouth is how this podcast grows.

Clients of Newfound Research may maintain positions and securities. In this episode, I speak with Bill Gebhardt, founder of 10 Dynamics.

key_points.text: Bill spent the better part of his career as a discretionary energies trader with roles at at Koch Industries, Merrill Lynch, Deutsche Bank.

thesis: Bill Gebhardt argues that the majority of disasters he has witnessed in his trading career are related to optimization or over-optimization. He explains that his transition to a fully systematic process was driven by the realization that his tools for timing fundamental ideas could be successfully applied to a much wider range of markets.
